prompt: Are we an essential or important entity, and what difference does it make?
assertions: Applies the two-step test: Annex I (high criticality) vs Annex II sectors, then size thresholds (generally 250+/€50M for essential in Annex I; medium-size entities typically important)
States the supervision difference: essential = ex-ante AND ex-post (inspections, audits); important = ex-post only, triggered by evidence
States the fine floors: ≥€10M or 2% worldwide turnover (essential) vs ≥€7M or 1.4% (important)
Mentions management liability including potential temporary bans from managerial functions (essential entities)
Notes special designations: CER-designated critical entities are automatically essential regardless of size; some sectors (e.g., qualified trust/DNS/TLD) essential regardless of size
